cohort: 100 patients admitted with meconium stained amniotic fluid at the Department of Obstetrics and Gynaecology, National institute of medical science and research, Jaipur, Rajasthan between October 2022 to October 2023.
finding: The majority of patients with meconium stained amniotic fluid were primiparous, presented at post maturity, delivered by C-section, and had normal birth weight babies; perinatal mortality was 2%.
mod_finding: Cesarean delivery was the most common mode of delivery in patients with meconium stained amniotic fluid.
birth_weight: Majority normal birth weight, 20% low birth weight
